verdict.rationale: Provisioning products, prices and payment links through an API is a fair question for a payment platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only says generically that the Paystack API can collect payments, manage transactions and do other operations available in the Dashboard. No cited item documents product, price or payment-link endpoints, or an agent creating all three in one session.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session
